questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/ subtracting /multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

34, 24

85, 75
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number - 2nd number = 10.**

34, 24

→ 34 - 24 

→ 10

And.

85, 75

→ 85 - 75

questions.question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some metres are litres.

No litre is a gram.

Conclusions

(I) Some grams are not metres

(II) All grams being metres is a possibility.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4495468c95695927df05b755e2a5413da3682a91a30822e1b134b8e1a65ed90d.png] 

**Conclusions**

(I) Some grams are not metres → False ( As, there is no direct relation between grams and metres)

(II) All grams being metres is a possibility → **True **(As, there is no direct relation between grams and metres but in possibility it can be true).

Thus, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) of the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

17 – 9 + 20 × 4 ÷ 5 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, after interchanging the signs:

 
 

 Original Sign
 +
 −
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 New Sign
 -
 +
 ÷
 ×
 
 

Now,

Given equation: 17 – 9 + 20 × 4 ÷ 5 = ?

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 17 + 9 - __**20 ÷ 4**__ × 5

⇒ 17 + 9 - __**5 × 5**__

⇒ __**17 + 9**__ - 25

⇒ __**26 - 25**__

⇒ 1

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
23 is related to 62 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 37 is related to 104. To which of the following is 19 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number × 3 - 7 = 2nd number.**

23 is related to 62 

→ 23 × 3 - 7 = 62. 

→ 69 - 7 = 62

And, 

37 is related to 104

→ 37 × 3 - 7

→ 111 - 7 = 104

Similarly,

19 is related to

→ 19 × 3 - 7

→ 57 - 7 = 50

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

39 + 3 ÷ 12 − 33 × 11 =?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, after interchanging the signs:

 
 

 Original Sign
 +
 −
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 New Sign
 -
 +
 ÷
 ×
 
 

Now,

Given equation: 39 + 3 ÷ 12 − 33 × 11 = ?

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 39 - __**3 × 12**__ + __**33 ÷ 11**__

⇒ __**39 - 36**__ + 3

⇒ __**3 + 3**__

⇒ 6

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
